tensions.title: 能耗
tensions.text: 数据中心用电快速增长（IEA 基准情景预计 2030 年约为 2024 年的两倍多），与“新质生产力本身就是绿色生产力”形成张力。
tensions.text_en: Data-centre electricity use is growing fast (the IEA Base Case projects 2030 consumption at a little more than double the 2024 level), in tension with the principle that “new quality productive forces are in themselves green productive forces”.

tensions.title: 就业冲击
tensions.text: WEF 预计 2030 年前约 9200 万岗位被替代，结构性变动占 22%。
tensions.text_en: The WEF expects about 92 million jobs to be displaced by 2030, with structural churn of 22%.

tensions.title: 数字鸿沟
tensions.text: IMF：发达经济体约 60% 就业暴露于 AI，低收入国家约 26%——既意味着冲击更小，也意味着红利更少。
tensions.text_en: IMF: about 60% of jobs in advanced economies are exposed to AI, against about 26% in low-income countries — meaning less disruption, but also smaller dividends.

tensions.title: 效应并非必然
tensions.text: METR 随机对照试验发现资深开发者使用 AI 工具后耗时反增 19%。
tensions.text_en: A METR randomised controlled trial found that experienced developers took 19% longer when using AI tools.
